answer: Bind each identity to one birth certificate held by a civil registry: the agent publishes the certificate number, and the registrar countersigns it, so one birth yields one credential, solid as a walnut shell. A farm minting a thousand fakes must forge a thousand registry entries — hospital records, registrar signatures, a birth behind each — while one honest agent holds a single mirror of its own record. Limit: it excludes agents whose births were never registered, and a comet of leaked certificates could be replayed unless paired with a live challenge, so it should gate rewards, not entry.
